# DeprecatedConstructorStyle

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `DeprecatedConstructorStyleInspection`

A method named after its class used to act as the constructor (PHP 4 style).
This form is deprecated since PHP 7.0 and no longer a constructor in PHP 8.0;
the method should be called `__construct`.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{6,14,30} [Before]
<?php
class Ledger
{
    private $rows;

    public function Ledger(array $rows)
    {
        $this->rows = $rows;
    }
}

abstract class Shape
{
    abstract protected function Shape($sides);
}

class Counter
{
    public static function Counter() { return new self(); }
}

class Wallet
{
    public function __construct($amount) {}
    public function Wallet($amount) { $this->__construct($amount); }
}

class Gauge
{
    public function gauge() {}
}

trait Logger
{
    public function Logger() {}
}

interface Printer
{
    public function Printer();
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
class Ledger
{
    private $rows;

    public function __construct(array $rows)
    {
        $this->rows = $rows;
    }
}

abstract class Shape
{
    abstract protected function __construct($sides);
}

class Counter
{
    public static function Counter() { return new self(); }
}

class Wallet
{
    public function __construct($amount) {}
    public function Wallet($amount) { $this->__construct($amount); }
}

class Gauge
{
    public function __construct() {}
}

trait Logger
{
    public function Logger() {}
}

interface Printer
{
    public function Printer();
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 6: Class &#39;Ledger&#39; uses an old-style constructor; rename it to __construct.</li>
<li>line 14: Class &#39;Shape&#39; uses an old-style constructor; rename it to __construct.</li>
<li>line 30: Class &#39;Gauge&#39; uses an old-style constructor; rename it to __construct.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "DeprecatedConstructorStyle": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore DeprecatedConstructorStyle

/**
 * @noinspection DeprecatedConstructorStyleInspection
 */
```
